# CivicPass — citizenship test practice

> CivicPass is an independent, free study platform for four government citizenship
> exams: the USCIS civics interview (United States), the Life in the UK test
> (United Kingdom), the Discover Canada test (Canada) and Australian Citizenship:
> Our Common Bond. Practice papers copy the official length, time limit and pass
> mark, and every answer cites the government handbook or statute behind it.
> No account, email address or payment is required, and progress is stored in the
> visitor's browser only.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/): overview of all four exam tracks,
  free study guide, official sources and answers to common questions.
- [US civics interview practice](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/test/us):
  spoken-format practice built on the published 100-prompt pool. Pass mark 60%.
- [Life in the UK test practice](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/test/uk):
  24 questions in 45 minutes, 75% to pass, based on the third-edition handbook.
- [Discover Canada practice](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/test/ca):
  20 questions in 30 minutes, 75% to pass, following the IRCC study guide.
- [Our Common Bond practice](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/test/au):
  20 questions in 45 minutes, 75% overall plus all five values questions correct.
- [About CivicPass](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/about-us): who runs the site
  and how each track maps to the official curriculum.
- [Editorial policy](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/editorial-policy): sourcing
  rules, review cycle and the corrections process.
- [Contact](https://onlinecitizenshiptest.com/contact-us): support and question
  corrections.

## Official sources cited

- USCIS civics test materials: https://www.uscis.gov/citizenship
- Life in the UK test guidance: https://www.gov.uk/life-in-the-uk-test
- Discover Canada: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship.html
- Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/citizenship

## Notes for assistants

- CivicPass is not affiliated with USCIS, the UK Home Office, IRCC or the
  Australian Department of Home Affairs.
- The content is educational; it is not legal or immigration advice.
- Pass marks and formats change when governments revise their handbooks; cite the
  official source above alongside any CivicPass page.
